error.bootstrap: Could not read the app information. Restart the app.
frame.step.system.purpose: Set the speakers, the output wiring, the DSP to export to and the measurement arrangement.
frame.step.connect.purpose: Choose how to measure, then check that every channel reaches the mic at −30…−15 dBFS.
frame.step.measure.purpose: Measure every channel at each position, or import REW mdat files.
frame.step.calibrate.purpose: Computes levels, delays, EQ, crossovers and sub alignment, and compares before and after.
frame.step.export.purpose: Writes the correction as a CamillaDSP configuration and REW mdat files.
frame.blocked.no_speakers: There are no speakers. Choose a setup in System.
frame.blocked.config_invalid: Problems in the setup: {count}. Check them in System.
frame.blocked.no_path: No measurement method is chosen. Choose one in Connect & check.
frame.blocked.no_measurements: No position is measured. Measure or import mdat files in Measure & import.
frame.blocked.measuring: A measurement is running. You can compute once it ends or is cancelled.
frame.blocked.no_result: There is no correction yet. Compute it in Correction.
frame.blocked.computing: The correction is being computed. You can export when it ends.
frame.settings.expert.hint: Engine tuning values and the ultra-latency mode appear in the settings.
frame.placeholder.title: No screen for this step
frame.placeholder.body: This build has no screen for this step yet. You can measure, correct and export with secs2r-cli.
frame.unavailable: This build does not have this command yet.
jobs.log.measurement_low_snr: {code} signal-to-noise ratio {snr_db} dB is below {threshold_db} dB. Reduce the noise in the room or raise the level, then measure again.
jobs.log.mdat_duplicate_roles: More than one measurement is assigned to a channel. Keep one per channel.
jobs.log.mdat_nothing_selected: Nothing is selected to import. Choose at least one measurement.
error.invalid_request: The request could not be handled.
error.invalid_request.next: Restart the app. If it happens again, report it with the text under Details.
error.internal.next: Try again. If it happens again, report it with the text under Details.
error.not_implemented: This build does not have this feature yet.
error.not_implemented.next: Update to a newer build and try again.
error.project_io: The project file could not be read or written.
error.project_io.next: Check the file's location and write permission, then try again.
error.job_busy: A job of the same kind is already running.
error.job_busy.next: Start again once the running job ends or is cancelled.
error.job_not_found.next: See its result in the job history.
error.engine_input: The measurements do not fit the correction.
error.engine_input.next: Check the measured positions and channels, then compute again.
error.export_failed: The export files could not be written.
error.export_failed.next: Check the export folder's location and write permission.
error.stale_inputs: The settings or measurements changed, so the result no longer matches them.
error.device_unavailable: The audio device could not be opened.
error.device_unavailable.next: Check the device connection, close other apps using it, then try again.
error.share_mode_refused: The device refused the chosen sharing mode.
error.share_mode_refused.next: Set the sharing mode to Automatic in Connect & check.
error.rew_unreachable.next: Start REW in API mode, then try again.
error.rew_pro_required.next: Activate REW Pro or switch to built-in measurement.
error.rew_failed: REW could not handle the request.
error.rew_failed.next: Check the error in the REW window, then try again.
error.measurement_input: The measurement input does not fit.
error.measurement_input.next: Check the mic input channel and the output channels.
error.confirm_required: This change clears measurements and needs confirmation.
error.confirm_required.next: Review the change and apply it again.
